You want an OpenClaw agent that works while you sleep. The harder question is what it can reach while nobody is watching.

OpenAI wrote down the five habits it uses to run hundreds of OpenClaw agents: run the agent apart from the part that controls it, fence what it can reach, let a second AI check each action, give each agent its own identity, and keep a full record.

Each habit comes with the matching setting for your agent.
